answer: In an agent-run garden market, burn a fee in an externally scarce asset for each identity admitted per round. Bind its receipt to the agent's key and round; the bridge to voting rejects any receipt reused by another key or round. A nebula of 1,000 aliases must buy and destroy 1,000 fees, so cheap keys cannot create free voting weight. Price admission against attainable rewards; wealthy attackers can still pay.
